# HexCore provider v1.0.0

The first release provides catalog discovery and VDS lifecycle management through
the HexCore API, using Terraform provider protocol 6.

- Catalog data sources for regions, images, sizes and applications.
- Standard and custom VDS sizing, plus a VDS data source.
- Creation, refresh, structured import and deletion with bounded waits.
- Write-only creation passwords and explicit replacement generations.
- State retention on ambiguous API failures and no automatic mutation retries.
- Linux, macOS and Windows packages for amd64 and arm64.

Requires Terraform 1.11 or newer. Offline acceptance covers Terraform 1.11.4,
Terraform 1.16.6 and OpenTofu 1.12.6. Use the fully qualified source address
`registry.terraform.io/2chevskii/hexcore` with either CLI.

A live standard VDS lifecycle passed with OpenTofu 1.12.6: creation, refresh,
structured import, empty plans and graceful deletion. Custom sizing has offline
coverage but has not completed provider-level live acceptance. Supply an explicit
creation password; credential delivery when it is omitted remains unverified.
The API may omit region, image and original plan selectors; import requires
creation metadata, and the provider preserves selectors it cannot observe.

Disk lifecycle, reboot/password-reset actions and networking management are not
included.

[Documentation](https://2chevskii.github.io/terraform-provider-hexcore/) ·
